# OmniMD

> OmniMD provides integrated EHR, RCM, and AI-powered solutions to help healthcare practices streamline operations, reduce administrative burden, and grow revenue.

OmniMD offers a comprehensive suite of healthcare software including electronic health records, practice management, medical billing, and AI-driven automation tools designed for ambulatory clinics, solo practitioners, and multi-specialty practices. The platform emphasizes interoperability through HL7/FHIR standards and includes advanced features like AI medical scribing, intelligent front desk automation, and remote patient monitoring.

## Key Topics

- EHR (Electronic Health Records)
- RCM (Revenue Cycle Management)
- AI Medical Scribe
- Practice Management System
- Medical Billing Software
- HIPAA Compliance
- Telehealth
- Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
- Patient Portal
- E-Prescribing
- HL7/FHIR Integration
- Healthcare Automation
- Clinical Documentation
- AI Front Desk
- OmniXchange

## Core EHR & Practice Management

- [EHR Software for Ambulatory Clinics](https://omnimd.com/ehr-software): Core EHR software product for ambulatory clinics with AI charting
- [Practice Management System for Clinics](https://omnimd.com/practice-management): Cloud-based Practice Management System for clinic operations
- [EHR for Solo Practitioners That Simplifies Care](https://omnimd.com/ehr-for-solo-practitioners): EHR solution designed for solo practitioners with AI tools
- [Physician Dashboard](https://omnimd.com/ehr-software/physician-dashboard): Physician Dashboard with real-time analytics and performance metrics

## AI-Powered Clinical Tools

- [AI Medical Scribe for Clinicians and Providers](https://omnimd.com/ai-medical-scribe): AI Medical Scribe automates charting and clinical documentation
- [AI Clinicians by OmniMD: Save 5+ Hours Weekly](https://omnimd.com/ai-clinician-software): AI Clinician Platform saves providers 5+ hours weekly on documentation
- [AI SOAP Note Generator for Clinics & Hospitals](https://omnimd.com/ai-soap-note-generator): AI SOAP Note Generator for accurate clinical documentation
- [AI Front Desk - Medical Receptionist for Clinics](https://omnimd.com/ai-front-desk): AI Front Desk automates calls, refills, and patient requests

## Revenue Cycle Management & Billing

- [AI RCM by OmniMD - Reduce Denials & Accelerate Payments](https://omnimd.com/ai-rcm-software): AI RCM transforms billing with automation and denial prevention
- [Medical Billing Software for Clinics](https://omnimd.com/medical-billing-software): Medical Billing Software for faster claims processing and revenue
- [Medical Billing Services for Clinics & Practices](https://omnimd.com/medical-billing-services): Medical Billing Services with expert RCM support and automation
- [Request Your Free RCM Audit](https://omnimd.com/rcm-billing-audit): Free RCM audit service to optimize billing and maximize revenue

## Patient Engagement & Digital Health

- [Digital Health Software for Modern Practices](https://omnimd.com/digital-health): Digital Health platform for virtual care and patient engagement
- [Patient Portal Software by OmniMD](https://omnimd.com/patient-portal): Patient Portal for 24/7 health records, scheduling, and billing
